summary: The Government of Canada advises exercising a high degree of caution for travel to Indonesia due to political and social tensions and the threat of terrorism throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include all provinces of Indonesian Papua (except Raja Ampat Regency and Sorong city) due to violent incidents, threats against foreigners, and kidnapping risks, as well as Aceh province and East and West Kalimantan due to kidnapping threats.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Thailand is under an overall advisory of 'Exercise a high degree of caution' due to ongoing political tensions, sporadic demonstrations, and a persistent terrorism threat. Specific regions with higher warnings include the Thailand-Cambodia border (avoid all travel due to armed clashes and land mines) and the southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, and southern Songkhla (avoid all travel due to violent separatist insurgent attacks).

summary: The Government of Canada advises exercising a high degree of caution in Türkiye due to the threat of terrorist attacks and possible demonstrations throughout the country. Avoid all travel to within 10 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria, and avoid non-essential travel to the southeastern provinces of Hakkari and Șirnak due to the unpredictable security situation and terrorism threats.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Egypt is under an advisory to exercise a high degree of caution due to ongoing regional tensions, an unpredictable security situation, and the threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include Northern Sinai (avoid all travel due to terrorist activity and military operations), the Western Desert and Libyan border area (avoid all travel due to smuggling, terrorist activities, and armed groups), and the northern part of South Sinai (avoid non-essential travel due to terrorism).

The Government of Canada advises Canadians to avoid non-essential travel to Kuwait due to the volatile security situation in the region, including missile and drone attacks striking civilian infrastructure. There is an ongoing threat of terrorism, particularly near foreign military installations, places of worship, and public areas frequented by foreigners. The border area with Iraq, specifically within 5 km of the border, is under a higher advisory level of 'Avoid all travel' due to unexploded ordnance from the 1991 Gulf War.

Avoid non-essential travel to Israel due to the volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity, terrorism, and potential travel disruptions. Specific areas with higher warnings include Jerusalem (avoid non-essential travel), the Golan Heights border with Syria (avoid all travel), the area within 5 km of the Lebanon border (avoid all travel), and the area within 10 km of the Gaza Strip border (avoid all travel). The West Bank also faces high tensions and frequent violent clashes.
